title: Alexa's Rubies
description: Replaces emeralds with rubies. Comes in both modern and programmer art styles.
body:
This resource pack (like many others) adds rubies back to Minecraft, replacing emeralds. The difference is... I made it! It comes in both modern and programmer art styles. The modern version uses the item texture from Minecraft Earth and a unique block texture based on a scrapped emerald block texture. The programmer art version uses the OG item texture and just a recolored emerald block texture.

![Modern rubies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e31f57588e185520c7e7e3887e2ccc8df89b103.png)
![Programmer rubies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0e2c90c37112a9fb14d4a6d2f58a52c0acf0ec8.png)

There is a secret third version I made for personal use that uses textures from the mod Rubinated Nether, which I likely won't release since the textures are stolen.
